discriminating_phenotype: Absence of Severe Epileptic Encephalopathy / Infantile Refractory Spasms
discriminating_logic: Seizure penetrance in TAF4 is <30% (<2/8), manifesting as isolated febrile or easily controlled episodes rather than catastrophic infantile spasms or progressive refractory encephalopathy seen in severe early-onset neurodevelopmental encephalopathies like select TAF1 cohorts.
